name: Stop the Spread

angles.text: As a Skyborne adventurer, you are warned to avoid bites while carrying out the grim orders near the Greymane Wall.
As Forsaken, you are immune to the worgen affliction. You can take part in containment without risk of infection.
As a human, you may be among the uninfected refugees at the sealed Greymane Wall. Forsaken researchers see them as possible carriers of Arugal's curse.

faq.answer: Stop the Spread concerns containing the worgen curse in Silverpine Forest. Forces target human refugees near the Greymane Wall to keep Archmage Arugal from gaining more servants.
faq.q: What is the quest Stop the Spread about?

faq.answer: Archmage Arugal is blamed for the worgen in Silverpine Forest, whether through deliberate acts or unforeseen effects of his magic. His growing pack threatens the region.
faq.q: Who is responsible for the worgen in Silverpine?

faq.answer: Forsaken research indicates that the worgen curse cannot infect the undead. Forsaken forces can face the danger without becoming Arugal's beastly servants.
faq.q: Can the Forsaken catch the worgen curse?

faq.answer: Many human refugees have gathered outside the sealed Greymane Wall. Since living humans can catch Arugal's curse, the Forsaken fear they may swell the worgen's ranks.
faq.q: Why are human refugees being targeted at the Greymane Wall?

faq.answer: Researchers in Silverpine Forest know that worgen infection can pass through bites. The exact workings of the magic and the body remain unclear.
faq.q: How does the worgen affliction spread?

aliases: can the worgen curse be cured
faq.answer: No cure for the worgen affliction is known. Researchers seek a way to halt it, while containment remains their immediate concern.
faq.q: Is there a way to stop or cure the worgen curse?

sections.body: In Silverpine Forest, worgen spread under renegade Archmage Arugal's hand. Researchers do not yet know exactly how the feral affliction passes from one victim to another. Its danger to the territory is plain. They study the magic while trying to keep Arugal from gathering an overwhelming host of savage followers.
sections.title: The Silverpine Affliction

sections.body: Forsaken investigators have found that their undead bodies resist worgen infection. Living humans have no such defense. At Silverpine Forest's southern border, human refugees gather in desperation beside the locked gates of the Greymane Wall. The Forsaken fear the refugees will be bitten and made Arugal's loyal servants. So ruthless orders call for their removal before the affliction can claim them.
sections.title: Containment at the Wall

summary: At Silverpine Forest's southern border, refugees gather by the Greymane Wall as Arugal's worgen spread. Researchers seek a way to halt the affliction, while orders aim to keep the living refugees from becoming his servants.
attribution: In-game quest text: Stop the Spread
